violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. 2 door upright refrigerator in kitchen has products temping at 46 degrees F.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Seal bare wood surfaces of shelving unit built to support microwaves in kitchen.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Cabinets showing wear. Peeling laminate exposing bare-wood surfaces. Other bare-wood surfaces not properly sealed.
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
